title: Northern Lights seen as far south as London

tellings.quote: the northern lights were seen as far south as London right here actually I didn't see them myself cuz it was cloudy

plain: In 2024 the northern lights, the glowing night sky usually seen only near the poles, were seen as far south as London. The scientist Rupert Sheldrake mentions it from what others told him, adding that he did not see them himself "cuz it was cloudy."
